description: Additional data sources stay scoped to observed/public API contracts and actual access failures; no speculative credential propagation or zero-volume substitutes.

capabilities.title: Read documented region/category charts using an actual API-key provider
capabilities.blocker: Native chart client/key provider/current replay absent. Since2025-07-21 mostPopular is Music/Movies/Gaming charts; not all-topic trending. Cumulative statistics do not prove chart-period volume.

capabilities.title: Read actual public Shopping Insight rank JSON after anonymous bootstrap
capabilities.blocker: Current bootstrap emittedNNB but no requiredBUC, so SESSION_BOOTSTRAP stops. Current direct200HTML is not valid rankingJSON. This public client does not depend on DPAPI or account login.

capabilities.title: Read documented relative interest for supplied keyword groups
capabilities.blocker: Developer ClientID/Secret provider and current replay unavailable. Relative max100 score is not keyword discovery/absolute search volume.

capabilities.title: Read authorized service aggregate with current owner-bound session/signature
capabilities.blocker: Current first-party JS/historical contracts only; existing WindowsDPAPI provider unavailable on Linux, no current native owner-bound aggregate JSON replay. Exclude channel-bound private analytics.
